verdicts.ar: كان من أجلّ أصحاب الأوزاعي وأقدمهم
verdicts.en: Among the most eminent and earliest of al-Awza'i's students.

bio: One of the senior students of al-Awza'i. Abu Dawud, al-Tirmidhi and al-Nasa'i transmit from him.
